quests.instruction: Your phone rings loudly with a silly ringtone during a silent school assembly. How do you feel?
quests.question: Embarrassed
quests.hint: This is the warm-cheeked feeling right after an obvious, noticeable slip-up, not the quiet feeling of a new place.
quests.explanation: This is embarrassed rather than shy — embarrassed follows an obvious, noticeable slip-up, while shy comes from being somewhere unfamiliar instead.
quests.funFact: Switching your phone to silent before an assembly is a simple way to avoid this exact moment!

quests.instruction: You are about to try out for a team, something you have wanted to do for a long time. How do you feel?
quests.question: Nervous
quests.hint: This is the fluttery feeling before showing your skills, not true fear of danger.
quests.explanation: This is nervous rather than scared — nervous fits this fluttery feeling before showing your skills, since there is no real danger here.
quests.funFact: Many athletes say a little of this fluttery feeling actually helps them perform their best!

quests.instruction: You have retied your shoe five times and it keeps coming undone again. How do you feel?
quests.question: Frustrated
quests.hint: This is the stuck feeling of a small problem repeating, not the hot feeling of something unfair.
quests.explanation: This is frustrated rather than angry — frustrated fits a small problem repeating again and again, while angry usually comes from something feeling unfair.
quests.funFact: A double-knot is a simple trick that can finally solve this exact repeating problem!

quests.instruction: You and your family sing together in the car with the windows down. How do you feel?
quests.question: Joyful
quests.hint: Singing loudly and freely with people you love feels like deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.explanation: Singing loudly and freely with people you love fills you with deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.funFact: Singing together is known to help families feel especially close and happy together!

quests.instruction: You are on a long trip and keep wishing you could see your pet again. How do you feel?
quests.question: Homesick
quests.hint: Missing someone familiar back home, even a pet, can give you a longing feeling.
quests.explanation: Missing someone familiar back home, even a pet, gives you a longing, quiet feeling.
quests.funFact: Looking at a photo of a pet you miss can help this longing feeling feel a little lighter.

quests.instruction: You are stuck inside all week because of nonstop, heavy rain. How do you feel?
quests.question: Miserable
quests.hint: A whole week without any relief from something unpleasant can feel like a heavy, deep low.
quests.explanation: A whole week without any relief from something unpleasant can leave you with a heavy, deep, low feeling.
quests.funFact: Planning a fun indoor project ahead of time can help a rainy week feel a little less heavy!

quests.instruction: You are stuck doing chores on a day you wanted to just relax, and you keep huffing about it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Grumpy
quests.hint: Having your relaxing plans replaced with chores can put you in a grumbly, huffing mood.
quests.explanation: Having your relaxing plans replaced with chores can put you in a grumbly, short-tempered mood.
quests.funFact: Turning on music while doing chores is a trick that can sometimes soften a grumbly mood!

quests.instruction: You keep staring at your cousin's fancy new video game system. How do you feel?
quests.question: Envious
quests.hint: Wishing you owned something shiny and new that belongs to someone else can feel wistful.
quests.explanation: Wishing you owned something shiny and new that belongs to someone else gives you a wistful feeling.
quests.funFact: Playing together is a great way to enjoy something new even when it is not yours!

quests.instruction: You planned a picnic for weeks, and it only gets cancelled because of one small rain shower. How do you feel?
quests.question: Disappointed
quests.hint: This feeling is about one plan not working out, not a deep, heavy low that lasts a long time.
quests.explanation: This is disappointed rather than miserable — one cancelled plan is a letdown, while miserable describes a much heavier, longer-lasting low.
quests.funFact: Rescheduling a picnic for another day often turns this letdown right back into excitement!

quests.instruction: You run through freshly fallen leaves, laughing the whole way. How do you feel?
quests.question: Joyful
quests.hint: Playing freely outside without a care feels like deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.explanation: Playing freely outside without a care fills you with deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.funFact: Simple outdoor moments like this are often the ones people remember most fondly!

quests.instruction: You have been away for a whole week and cannot stop thinking about home. How do you feel?
quests.question: Homesick
quests.hint: A longer time away from home can make familiar comforts feel extra missed.
quests.explanation: A longer time away from home can make familiar comforts feel extra missed, giving you a longing feeling.
quests.funFact: A phone call with someone from home can help this longing feeling feel much lighter.

quests.instruction: Your shoes get soaked, then you miss the bus, then you forget your lunch, all in one morning. How do you feel?
quests.question: Miserable
quests.hint: A whole chain of unlucky little things happening back-to-back can feel like a heavy, deep low.
quests.explanation: A whole chain of unlucky little things happening back-to-back can leave you with a heavy, deep, low feeling.
quests.funFact: Mornings like this usually make for a good story to laugh about later on!

quests.instruction: You had to wake up before sunrise and cannot stop sighing about it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Grumpy
quests.hint: A morning that starts far earlier than usual can put you in a grumbly, sighing mood.
quests.explanation: A morning that starts far earlier than usual can put you in a grumbly, short-tempered mood.
quests.funFact: Getting a little natural light in the morning can help your body feel less grumbly about waking early!

quests.instruction: You cannot stop looking at your friend's cool new backpack during class. How do you feel?
quests.question: Envious
quests.hint: Wishing you had something nice that a friend just got can give you a wistful, wanting feeling.
quests.explanation: Wishing you had something nice that a friend just got gives you a wistful, wanting feeling.
quests.funFact: Complimenting a friend's new things, even with this feeling, is a kind habit worth practicing!

quests.instruction: You studied hard and still scored a few points below the grade you were hoping for. How do you feel?
quests.question: Disappointed
quests.hint: This is the letdown of almost reaching a goal, not a feeling of having done something wrong.
quests.explanation: This is disappointed rather than guilty — you did nothing wrong; it is simply the letdown of a goal falling just short.
quests.funFact: A close score is often a sign you are very close to reaching your next goal!

quests.instruction: You splash and laugh with your cousins in the sprinkler on a hot day. How do you feel?
quests.question: Joyful
quests.hint: Playing and laughing freely with family on a fun summer day feels like deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.explanation: Playing and laughing freely with family on a fun summer day fills you with deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.funFact: Simple outdoor play like this is one of the purest ways kids experience deep happiness!

quests.instruction: You are at a sleepover and quietly wish you were back in your own house. How do you feel?
quests.question: Homesick
quests.hint: Missing the comfort of your own house, even during something fun, can feel like a quiet longing.
quests.explanation: Missing the comfort of your own house, even during something fun, gives you a quiet, longing feeling.
quests.funFact: Telling a trusted grown-up how you feel is a brave, helpful step if this feeling grows too big.

quests.instruction: You lose your favorite toy on the same day you also miss the school bus. How do you feel?
quests.question: Miserable
quests.hint: Several unlucky things happening in the very same day can add up to a heavy, deep low feeling.
quests.explanation: Several unlucky things happening in the very same day can add up to a heavy, deep, low feeling.
quests.funFact: Tough days like this usually pass, and tomorrow gets a completely fresh start.

quests.instruction: You have a small headache and just want everyone to leave you alone. How do you feel?
quests.question: Grumpy
quests.hint: Feeling a little unwell can make you want peace and quiet instead of chatting.
quests.explanation: Feeling a little unwell can make you want peace and quiet, giving you a grumbly, short mood.
quests.funFact: A quiet rest in a dim room can help a grumbly, achy feeling pass more quickly.

quests.instruction: You keep thinking about how much cooler your friend's new sneakers look. How do you feel?
quests.question: Envious
quests.hint: Wishing you had something stylish that a friend just got can give you a wistful feeling.
quests.explanation: Wishing you had something stylish that a friend just got gives you a wistful, wanting feeling.
quests.funFact: Everyone's own personal style is different — that is part of what makes style fun to explore!

quests.instruction: Your whole family bursts out laughing together at breakfast. How do you feel?
quests.question: Joyful
quests.hint: A whole family laughing together over something silly feels like deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.explanation: A whole family laughing together over something silly fills you with deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.funFact: Shared laughter first thing in the morning can set a joyful tone for the whole day!

quests.instruction: You are away at camp for the first time and keep thinking about your own bed. How do you feel?
quests.question: Homesick
quests.hint: Missing the comfort and familiarity of your own house can give you a longing, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: Missing the comfort and familiarity of your own house gives you a longing, quiet feeling.
quests.funFact: Bringing something familiar, like a small photo, can help this longing feeling feel smaller at camp!

quests.instruction: You catch a bad cold right before the weekend you had big plans for. How do you feel?
quests.question: Miserable
quests.hint: Feeling unwell right when your plans fall through too can feel like a heavy, deep low.
quests.explanation: Feeling unwell right when your plans fall through too can leave you with a heavy, deep, low feeling.
quests.funFact: Resting and drinking plenty of water are two of the best ways to help your body feel better faster.

quests.instruction: It is too early and you grumble through your entire breakfast. How do you feel?
quests.question: Grumpy
quests.hint: Waking up earlier than your body wants to can put you in a grumbly mood.
quests.explanation: Waking up earlier than your body wants to can put you in a grumbly, short-tempered mood.
quests.funFact: Getting ready the night before can sometimes help mornings feel a little less rushed and grumbly!

quests.instruction: You keep noticing how much taller your classmate's sandcastle turned out. How do you feel?
quests.question: Envious
quests.hint: Comparing your work to someone else's bigger result can give you a wistful, wanting feeling.
quests.explanation: Comparing your work to someone else's bigger result gives you a wistful, wanting feeling.
quests.funFact: Every sandcastle, tall or small, took real effort and creativity to build!

quests.instruction: Music starts playing at the party and you cannot stop dancing and smiling. How do you feel?
quests.question: Joyful
quests.hint: Moving and smiling without even thinking about it feels like deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.explanation: Moving and smiling without even thinking about it fills you with deep, bubbling happiness.
quests.funFact: Music and movement together are known to boost happy feelings even more than either one alone!

quests.instruction: You are on a school trip and keep thinking about your family back home. How do you feel?
quests.question: Homesick
quests.hint: Missing familiar faces while you are somewhere new can give you a longing feeling.
quests.explanation: Missing familiar faces while you are somewhere new gives you a longing, quiet feeling.
quests.funFact: Writing a postcard home is a fun way to feel connected to family while you are away!

quests.instruction: You are sick on the exact day of the class party you were looking forward to. How do you feel?
quests.question: Miserable
quests.hint: Missing something you looked forward to because you feel unwell can add up to a heavy, low feeling.
quests.explanation: Missing something you looked forward to because you feel unwell can leave you with a heavy, low feeling.
quests.funFact: Classmates can often save you a treat or a photo from a party you had to miss!

quests.instruction: You did not get enough sleep and everything seems to bother you today. How do you feel?
quests.question: Grumpy
quests.hint: Being extra tired can make small things feel much more annoying than usual.
quests.explanation: Being extra tired can make small things feel much more annoying, giving you a grumbly mood.
quests.funFact: A good night's sleep is one of the best ways to help a grumbly mood feel lighter the next day!

quests.instruction: You keep noticing how much bigger your friend's new trampoline is than yours. How do you feel?
quests.question: Envious
quests.hint: Comparing the size of your own things to a friend's bigger one can give you a wistful feeling.
quests.explanation: Comparing the size of your own things to a friend's bigger one gives you a wistful, wanting feeling.
quests.funFact: Taking turns and sharing time on a trampoline is fun no matter whose backyard it is in!
